issues: None of the review checks found a problem. The diff only changes two LR schedule hyperparameters: WARMDOWN_RATIO goes from 0.5 to 0.1 and FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05. It does not touch the seed lines, the prepare.py import, the data, the evaluation call or the summary printing.
No bugs found that would make the result meaningless. A 10% warmdown that ends at 5% of the peak LR is a valid schedule.
The candidate scored 1.0673 against an incumbent mean of 1.0520, so it is 0.0153 bpb worse (lower is better). The negative z and the 'reject' decision both agree with that.
I couldn't recompute z independently because the two incumbent run values and their spread aren't given. The reported z = -2.282 implies a standard error of about 0.0067.

There is only one candidate run, so the result is a bit uncertain. But the gap is large and goes the expected way: shortening warmdown from 50% to 10% usually hurts in short fixed-time runs. A replicate is not worth a slot.
